question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Mrs. Sandhaya teaches us English.

options.text: English was being taught to us by Mrs. Sandhaya.
English has been taught to us by Mrs. Sandhaya.
English is taught to us by Mrs. Sandhaya.
English is being taught to us by Mrs. Sandhaya.

solution:
```html
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Mrs. Sandhaya teaches us English."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "English" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "teaches" to "is taught" (present s
